description: ISA-88 Part 4 (BatchML Comments.Comment): a comment on an entry of a batch production record.

properties.name: batch_comment_id
properties.description: Identity of the comment: its record entry id (BatchML Comment.EntryID).

properties.name: record_reference
properties.description: The entry the comment is about (BatchML Comment.RecordReference — the id of any record entry).

properties.name: person_name
properties.description: BatchML Comment.PersonID — a name (NameType), not the id of a person.

properties.name: batch_production_record_ref
properties.description: The record the comment is part of (BatchML nests it in BatchProductionRecord.Comments).

relationships.description: The record the comment is part of.

isa88.grain: one comment in a batch production record
isa88.note: ISA-88 Part 4 as MESA BatchML 0701 carries it (BatchML-BatchProductionRecord.xsd Comment). Core 4.1.0 (0.5.2, OPEN-0360, owner 09.10.2026).
isa88.mappingNote: Containment is PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent.
